reason: Carving the planks seems like a direct way to make the printing block.
expectation: I expect a carved printing block or a part for one.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water might make ink, but the block seems useful to make first.

effect: The printing block is ready; I can now work on the press or its ink.
reason: Combining the block with iron seems like the next step toward building the press.
expectation: I expect a printing press or a press component.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water may make ink, but I want to assemble the press first.

effect: The press is built, and the new goal is to print a page; the description confirms it needs ink and paper.
reaction: The screw mechanism makes the assembly clearer.
reason: Charcoal and water seem likely to make the ink needed for printing.
expectation: I expect ink or a material used to make it.

alternatives.reason: Placing paper prepares the press, but I expect the block needs ink first.

effect: Ink is ready, so I can prepare the press for printing.
reason: I'll place the ink at the press to prepare the block for printing.
expectation: I expect the ink to be placed at the press, ready for a printing step.

alternatives.reason: Paper also needs to go at the press, but I'll place the ink first.

effect: The ink is at the press, and paper can now be combined with it there.
reason: Combining paper with the ink at the press directly serves the goal of printing a page.
expectation: I expect a printed page, perhaps with the block's illustration.

effect: The printed pages complete the printing goal and show how the same illustration can be reproduced on multiple sheets.
reaction: Seeing the finished copies was satisfying after assembling and preparing the press.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the press was most worthwhile because its description explained how the screw presses paper against the carved block.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the ink was a straightforward preparation with little to consider.

surprise.text: The press description clarified how the iron screw and plate work together to make repeatable prints.

arbitrary.text: The block and iron producing the whole press felt somewhat abrupt, although the description explained the resulting mechanism.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter if it offered similarly clear explanations of how its constructions work, though the compatible-choice menu made the decisions fairly predictable.
